content.short: THEOS is a decentralized hybrid NFT marketplace that delivers a smart contract infrastructure.
content.description: THEOS is aiming to become the main digital destination for the majority of NFT users. To achieve that, THEOS will provide much more than an NFT marketplace with minting services. This expansion of services that THEOS will offer to its users will be delivered as a set of groundbreaking NFT inventions. Firstly, the THEOS inventionODYSSEY pools, will allow users to deposit their NFTs to receive instant liquidity in the form of ODYSSEY tokens. While the NFT is in the pool, anyone will be able to buy it even for a higher price than what was originally received.
content.meta: Find out about THEOS (THEOS) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
